title: Mick's 2017 Metabunk post calls the Dietrich account laughable

plain: On December 30, 2017, the skeptic Mick West wrote a post on Metabunk, an online forum he runs to debunk strange claims, in a thread about the Navy's infrared video of the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint. In the post he called laughable an interview with Navy commander Alex Dietrich, one of the pilots who said she saw the object. The interview had been put out by To The Stars Academy, a company set up to research UFOs. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff reads West's own post back to him during a debate, to press him on how he dismissed a witness's account.
